title: Tropical Storm Bertha forms in Gulf. See latest forecast.

title: Flow Batteries Move From Lab to Grid
desc: China brought the world's first large scale “flow” battery project online earlier this year, and developers in Europe are racing to build even bigger ones—signs that the energy storage battery technology is showing real-world promise.

title: Kelantan police require every OCS to make daily arrests under new anti-drug strategy
desc: KOTA BHARU: Police have introduced a new strategy to strengthen the fight against drug abuse by requiring every Officer-in-Charge of a Police Station (OCS) to make at least one drug-related arrest each day, effective July 15.
